title: Review of feat/invoices: 6 findings
summary: Code review triage: what the agent found in a branch, worst first, with a fix / leave / later call on each.
description: I read the 14 files `feat/invoices` changes against `main` (+612 −88). Six findings, worst first, each with the code. Pick what I fix; my call is pre-selected. I'll fix them on the branch, one commit each, and rerun the tests.

fields.label: 1 · Anyone can read any invoice

options.label: Fix it
options.description: Scope the query to the caller's account, add a test

fields.label: 2 · Totals drift by a cent
fields.text:
`lib/totals.ts:41` rounds each line before summing, so a 3-line invoice can be 0.01 off the PDF the accountant gets.

```ts
const total = lines.reduce((s, l) => s + round(l.qty * l.price), 0)
```

options.label: Fix it
options.description: Work in integer cents, round once

fields.label: 3 · 51 queries per invoice list
fields.text: `listInvoices` loads each invoice's customer in its own query: a 50-row page makes 51 round trips (380 ms on the staging data).

options.label: Fix it
options.description: One query with a join; about 20 ms

fields.label: 4 · PDFs render inside the request
fields.text: `POST /invoices/:id/send` renders the PDF before answering: 2–3 s for a long invoice, and a timeout above ~200 lines.

options.label: Fix it
options.description: Render in a background job and email when ready (half a day of work)

fields.label: 5 · Dead code
fields.text: `formatCurrencyOld` and `legacyTaxRate` have no callers left since this branch.

fields.label: 6 · Credit notes aren't tested
fields.text: Negative totals (credit notes) go through a branch of `computeTotals` that no test reaches.

options.label: Fix it
options.description: Add three cases: full credit, partial credit, credit above the balance

fields.label: Push the fixes to the branch when the tests pass
